## Brand & Style

This design system embodies refined technical minimalism, engineered for clarity, sustained focus, and low cognitive overhead. Heavily influenced by modern developer-first and product-driven interfaces, it avoids decorative excesses in favor of precise spatial cadence, subtle tonal shifts, and purposeful contrast.

The aesthetic leverages deep dark foundations with micro-contrast boundaries. Interactions are deliberate, frictionless, and understated. Color is never decorative; it denotes active state, priority execution, or progress. Typography remains purely humanist-neutral, prioritizing legibility and natural rhythm without display histrionics.

## Colors

The palette operates under a strict monochrome discipline illuminated by a single accent.

- **Canvas (`#0A0A0A`)**: Near-black root foundation across viewports.
- **Surface Elevation 1 (`#121212`)**: Primary card, panel, and container background.
- **Surface Elevation 2 (`#18181B`)**: Hover states, popovers, dropdown menus, and raised interactive wells.
- **Borders & Dividers (`rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08)`)**: Hairline boundaries providing structural clarity without drawing visual focus away from content.
- **Primary Accent (`#6366F1`)**: Reserved exclusively for active navigation states, primary call-to-actions, and dynamic progress indicators.
- **Typography & Icons**:
  - **High Contrast (`#EDEDED`)**: Page titles, active headings, and primary content.
  - **Body / Standard (`#D4D4D8`)**: General prose, data rows, and standard inputs.
  - **Muted / Labels (`#A1A1AA`)**: Metadata, labels, supporting context, and inactive iconography.
  - **Subtle (`#52525B`)**: Disabled elements, subtle borders, and placeholder text.

## Typography

Inter governs all textual communication. All labels and functional text must be rendered in natural sentence case; uppercase tracking and monospace alternatives are strictly prohibited.

- **Hierarchy**: Maintain compact typographic proportions. The primary page heading peaks at 24px semibold. Scale contrast relies on weight (`600` vs `400`) and tonal attenuation (`#EDEDED` down to `#A1A1AA`) rather than exaggerated point sizes.
- **Letter Spacing**: Subtle negative letter-spacing is applied to headings (`-0.02em` down to `-0.01em`) to tighten display rhythm. Body and labels remain at neutral (`0`) tracking to safeguard legibility across dense productivity layouts.

## Layout & Spacing

The spatial model balances structural rigidity with breathing room. A baseline 8px spatial grid dictates all layouts, complemented by half-step increments (4px) for micro-component internal padding.

- **Canvas & Sectioning**: Main containers favor maximum readability bounds (max-width `1200px` for dense data workspaces, `768px` for focused reading/input layouts), centered with fluid horizontal margins.
- **Form Factors**:
  - **Desktop (≥1024px)**: Outer margins set to `space-xl` (2.5rem), gutters fixed at `space-lg` (1.5rem). Sidebar navigation maintains a persistent 240px width.
  - **Tablet (768px - 1023px)**: Margins scale to `space-lg` (1.5rem), navigation contracts to an icon rail or collapsible panel.
  - **Mobile (<768px)**: Margins compress to `space-md` (1rem), gutters reduce to `space-sm` (0.5rem or 1rem). Multicolumn card grids collapse into single vertical stacks.

## Elevation & Depth

Depth is established strictly through tonal layering and hair-thin structural outlines rather than drop shadows.

- **Layering Principle**: Surfaces sit upon the root canvas (`#0A0A0A`) using elevated fill tiers: cards and panels use `#121212`, while overlays, dialogs, and popovers use `#18181B`.
- **Borders**: Every separated surface features a 1px border colored with `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08)`. Hover states on interactive cards increase border opacity to `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16)`.
- **Shadows**: Physical drop shadows are avoided. A minimal ambient diffusion (`0 12px 32px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45)`) is reserved solely for floating dialogs and dropdown menus to separate them from dense background data layers.

## Shapes

The design system maintains a uniform corner curvature of 8px (`rounded-md` / level 2), creating a precise yet soft boundary across interactive elements and containers.

- **Standard Elements (8px)**: Inputs, buttons, cards, list rows, popovers, and inner dialog containers.
- **Nested Structures**: When elements sit nested inside a parent card with `padding: 8px` or less, interior corners scale down to 4px (`rounded-sm`) to preserve visual concentricity.
- **Indicators & Status**: Inline pills or small status dots default to fully rounded (`rounded-full`), while structural tags retain the uniform 8px radius.

## Components

### Buttons
- **Primary**: Background `#6366F1`, text `#FFFFFF`, font size 14px, weight 500, height 36px, horizontal padding 14px, border radius 8px. Hover shifts background to `#4F46E5`.
- **Secondary / Default**: Background `#121212`, border 1px `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08)`, text `#EDEDED`. Hover background shifts to `#18181B` with border `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14)`.
- **Ghost**: Background transparent, text `#A1A1AA`. Hover background `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04)`, text `#EDEDED`.

### Cards & Panels
- Background `#121212`, border 1px `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08)`, border radius 8px, padding 24px.
- Interactive cards transition border color to `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16)` on hover with zero transform or elevation bounce.

### Form Inputs
- Background `#0A0A0A`, border 1px `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08)`, height 36px, horizontal padding 12px, border radius 8px, text 14px `#EDEDED`. Placeholder text styled in `#52525B`.
- Focus state: Border transitions to `#6366F1` with an outer 1px focus ring (`rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.25)`).

### Selection Controls (Checkbox & Radio)
- Checkboxes feature an 8px corner-softened square (4px border radius), radio elements are circular.
- Unchecked: Background transparent, border 1px `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14)`.
- Checked: Background `#6366F1`, border `#6366F1`, icon white.

### Navigation & Lists
- Navigation items use 8px border radius, padding 8px 12px, text 14px `#A1A1AA`.
- Active item: Text `#EDEDED`, background `rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.1)`, leading edge or text accent `#6366F1`.
- List rows feature subtle top/bottom borders of `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04)`, padding 12px 16px.

### Progress Bars
- Track: Height 4px or 6px, background `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08)`, border radius 9999px.
- Fill: Background `#6366F1`, border radius 9999px, smoothly transitions width.

### Badges & Chips
- Background `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04)`, border 1px `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08)`, text `#A1A1AA`, font size 12px, padding 2px 8px, border radius 8px.
